title: NovaOS Agent Manifest v2
description: Agent manifest schema v2. Backward compatible with v1 — all new fields are optional.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. v1 manifests are auto-upgraded.

protocol.description: Adapter selector, not a wire protocol. "A2A" is the canonical name for the SDK adapter; "ACP" is a deprecated legacy alias, still accepted for existing manifests.

publisher.description: Publisher identity — DNS-compatible slug (NEW in v2, required for marketplace registration).

base_image.description: Base container image for deployment (NEW in v2). Must use an official novaos base image.

required.description: Model IDs the agent must have available.

optional.description: Model IDs the agent can use if available.

author.description: Agent author (NEW in v2, required for marketplace publishing).

url.description: Agent service URL (v1 field, still supported).

metadata.description: v1 metadata block (deprecated in v2 — use top-level fields instead).

permissions.description: Declared permissions (NEW in v2). Replaces implicit capabilities.

network_egress.description: Allowlist of external domains the agent may call.

requiredSecrets.description: Secret keys the agent requires at runtime.

requiredConfig.description: Config keys the agent requires at runtime.

agent_module.description: MODULE:ATTR naming the AgentBuilder instance `novaos-cli publish` runs the SDK's Agent Card emitter against. Defaults to "server:agent", matching the Python scaffold template.

deployment_target.description: Intended consumption contexts. 'chat' = visible in marketplace and installable by users. 'api' = API-only, provisioned by admins for service accounts. Defaults to ['chat'] if omitted.

release_channel.description: Release channel for this version. Controls which user installations receive it. stable = all users, beta = opted-in users, canary = explicit testers only.

dependencies.description: Locked dependency versions for this agent version. Pinned at publish time.

skills.description: Skill package versions required by this agent.

mcp_servers.description: MCP server versions required by this agent.

llm_model.description: Pinned LLM model alias (e.g. 'gpt-4o-2024-11-20'). If absent, the platform default is used.

rollback_policy.description: Automatic rollback configuration. If enabled, the platform rolls back this version if post-promote evaluation drops below the threshold.

auto_rollback_on_eval_drop.description: If true, the platform will automatically rollback this version if post-promote eval score drops below eval_threshold.

eval_threshold.description: Minimum aggregate evaluation score required to keep this version in production after promotion.
